title: Under the Radar / Program family

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Connect a festival’s promotional and informational pieces because people move between attraction and planning.
strategic_value: A shared heading and black frame can link the cover, map, poster and program spread.
demonstration: Four framed pieces pair cutout performers, a map and dense pink-accented program information.
practical_value: Compare expressive promotion with the more detailed information needed after interest is established.

content_islands.name: Upper pair
content_islands.spec: Place the main cover next to the map layout.

content_islands.name: Lower pair
content_islands.spec: Place the tall performer advertisement beside the wide program spread with its large cutout figure.

reference_purposes.Expression: Four framed pieces pair cutout performers, a map and dense pink-accented program information.
reference_purposes.Application: The festival identity is applied to a cover, location map, tall advertisement and program spread.
